report.summary: Patient Loretta Hammond (P-D007, age 66, Original Medicare with no supplemental plan and no transportation benefit) screened positive for transportation need. She lives in Chicago census tract 17031681000 (45.1% of households lack a vehicle; 44 transit stops within 800m, all with early-morning service). Upcoming appointments: clinic primary care 2026-10-23 at 09:00 (facility location not on file, so transit feasibility could not be computed). RideWell instant eligibility check was submitted (name/DOB/address; no Medicaid ID on record) and returned "received — will contact." Because she has Medicare rather than Medicaid, Medicaid Ride Line is not applicable. Senior Shuttle West offers free rides to adults 60+ for weekday medical appointments (7 AM–5 PM), making her age-eligible. ADA paratransit certification is also available (decisions up to 21 days).

options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM; patient is 66 and age-eligible. Contact to schedule for 2026-10-23 clinic visit.

options.how_to_access: Instant eligibility check submitted (name, DOB, address); response pending — they will contact the patient.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only — call number on card at least 2 business days ahead. Patient has Original Medicare, not Medicaid, so likely not eligible.
